# Vendored MMD Tools

This directory contains the runtime Python package required by
`script/convert_mmd.py`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/MMD-Blender/blender_mmd_tools
- Commit: `d943a25e7b60532f675798818eb7165779facfb4`
- Commit date: 2022-01-01
- License: GPLv3; see `LICENSE`

The upstream `.git` directory, samples, tests, and generated Python bytecode
are intentionally not vendored.
